job.text:
Product Manager — Example Platform

You will own the product roadmap and turn product strategy into delivery plans.

Prioritize initiatives using expected customer impact and delivery effort.

Run customer interviews and use the findings to guide product decisions.

Work closely with engineering and design throughout discovery and delivery.

Align cross-functional stakeholders around priorities and trade-offs.

Coordinate product releases, including testing and rollout.

Use adoption data to identify friction and guide improvements.

Explain product decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Experience supporting international product launches is preferred.

Experience negotiating commercial supplier agreements is a plus.

SQL experience for exploring product and adoption data is desirable.

A relevant qualification or equivalent professional experience is expected.
